[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Quinoa Salad Jars: Cook quinoa, mix with chopped veggies, add protein sources, season, and portion into jars.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Lentil Soup: Cook lentils with diced veggies and spices, add canned tomatoes and broth, season, and portion.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Roasted Veggie Wraps: Roast veggies, cook wraps, assemble, and portion.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chicken and Veggie Stir-Fry: Cook chicken, stir-fry veggies, mix, and portion.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Black Bean and Corn Salad: Cook black beans and corn, mix with veggies, season, and portion.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Turkey and Avocado Salad: Cook turkey, mix with avocado and greens, season, and portion.
